comment: The public-API freeze (DESIGN.md §12): per module, the top-level declarations scripts/check-api.sh holds to the baseline in api/. "*" freezes the whole module; "Outer.Inner" freezes only Inner. The placeholder modules (AetherDecide, Aether) are left out until they have API (M4-M6). "enforce": false reports differences without failing; set it to true at the 0.1.0 freeze.
